title: Goose PvP pack [YLG]
description: This PvP Pack adds several pvp textures including netherite and diamond retextures, crystals, tnt, diamonds and more
body:
This Pack adds a bunch of rly nice looking items to the game. 
It changes Netherite to be a dark red, including totems, tridents, maces, obsidian, and more.
It changes Diamond to be a dark purple, including tnt
